title: How Selling to Chris Jenkins Works | Cash Offer Steps in VA
description: Each step from first call to closing when you sell your Hampton Roads house to Chris Jenkins, plus what he will not do.
h1: How Selling Your House to Me Works, Step by Step
lede: No surprises. Here is every step from first contact to closing, what I will tell you in writing, and what I will not do.
tldr: You tell me about the house, I review nearby closed sales and the condition, I give you a written offer with the math, you decide with no obligation, and a title company or attorney handles closing. I am a licensed Virginia REALTOR® and I will say in writing when I am the buyer.
service_name: How Selling to Chris Jenkins Works

sections.html:
1. You contact me. Use the form on this page or call. Tell me the address, what is wrong with the house, whether anyone lives there and your timeline.
  2. I review the property. I look at closed sales nearby and, where needed, walk the house.
  3. I give you a written offer with the price, who pays which closing costs, the closing date and the math. See how I calculate it.
  4. You decide. There is no obligation. I will also tell you what listing would likely net, so you can compare. See cash offer vs. listing.
  5. We sign a contract. The contract says in writing that I am the buyer and not acting as your agent. You are free to have an attorney or another agent review it first.
  6. Title work and closing. A title company or attorney handles closing, pays off your mortgage and any liens from the proceeds and records the deed.

sections.h2: What I Will Put in Writing
sections.html:
• The price, the closing date and who pays which costs.
  • That I am the buyer, and not your agent, when I am buying.
  • What stays with the house and what you take.
  • Any contingencies, such as clear title.

• Ask for an upfront fee.
  • Pressure you to sign the same day.
  • Hide the actual buyer or sell your contract to someone else without telling you.
  • Tell you a cash sale is better when listing would net you more.

I am a licensed Virginia REALTOR® with Better Homes and Gardens Real Estate – Native American Group, at 5224 Indian River Rd, Suite 104, Virginia Beach. Verify any license on the Virginia DPOR website, and use the checklist for vetting any cash buyer.

faqs: Is there any obligation when I ask for an offer?
No. You can compare my offer with listing and any other offer.
Do I need to clean out the house?
Usually not. I will say in writing what stays and what goes.
The offer states who pays what. A title company or attorney itemizes them.
Can I use my own attorney?
Do you buy houses with a mortgage?
Yes. The loan is paid off from the proceeds at closing.
What if there are problems with title?
The title company finds them. We deal with liens and probate issues before or at closing.
Use the form on this page or the phone number shown at the bottom of it.
No. Talk with a Virginia attorney about your situation.
